name: lumos
description: Project Lumos - mobile quick-dump and AI-refined ingestion to Hermes Kanban.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.serve:tailscale: echo Starting Lumos production server on Tailscale... && npm run build && tailscale serve --bg --https=443 http://localhost:3030
